thread.title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Holdings Increased by Rockefeller Management L.P.

author: ABMN Staff
title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Holdings Increased by Rockefeller Management L.P.

organizations.name: rockefeller management l.p. rockefeller capital management l.p.

text:
Rockefeller Capital Management L.P. raised its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.5% during the 2nd the company in its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The fund owned 74,067 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after purchasing an additional 1,059 shares during the period. Rockefeller Capital Management L.P.’s holdings in Apple were worth $13,710,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
A number of other institutional investors and hedge funds have also modified their holdings of AAPL. Delphi Private Advisors LLC purchased a new position in shares of Apple in the 2nd quarter worth $120,000. Quattro Financial Advisors LLC purchased a new position in shares of Apple in the 1st quarter worth $133,000. CX Institutional purchased a new position in shares of Apple in the 2nd quarter worth $135,000. Spectrum Financial Alliance Ltd LLC purchased a new position in shares of Apple in the 1st quarter worth $138,000. Finally, Macroview Investment Management LLC boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 220.3% in the 1st quarter. Macroview Investment Management LLC now owns 900 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $151,000 after buying an additional 619 shares during the last quarter. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 57.65% of the company’s stock.
